The party accuses Meta of restricting Lula’s online content ahead of the October 25 presidential runoff against Senator Flavio Bolsonaro. Meta denies the allegations.
recentArticles.explanation: Accusations of election interference and complaints to international bodies create political friction and democratic strain.

recentArticles.title: North Korea test-fires submarine-launched cruise missiles amid rising tensions
recentArticles.description: North Korea test-fired two types of submarine-launched strategic cruise missiles on Wednesday, state media KCNA reported Thursday, saying the launches posed no threat to neighbouring countries. The tests follow heightened tensions with South Korea after a September 21 landmine explosion in the Demilitarised Zone injured three South Korean soldiers.
recentArticles.explanation: Active military missile tests occurring amidst heightened border tensions and troop injuries reflect significant geopolitical danger.

recentArticles.title: Albania protests turn violent as protestors demand PM Rama's resignation
recentArticles.description: Anti-government protests in Albania’s capital Tirana turned violent for a second consecutive night on Wednesday, leaving several government buildings damaged and at least one ablaze. Thousands demanded Prime Minister Edi Rama’s resignation and improved university conditions. Police fired tear gas and deployed water cannons as protesters smashed windows and attacked buildings.
recentArticles.explanation: Violent protests involving building damage, arson, and police clashes represent severe civil unrest and social instability.

recentArticles.title: PSG beat Manchester City in Champions League after financial rules verdict
recentArticles.description: Defending champions Paris Saint-Germain held off a second-half comeback to beat Manchester City 4-2 away in the Champions League on Wednesday. Goals from Desire Doue, Ousmane Dembele and Vitinha gave PSG a 3-0 lead before Erling Haaland struck twice. Maghnes Akliouche added a fourth, while Ferran Torres missed a late penalty.
recentArticles.explanation: A high-profile football match victory in a major tournament represents standard competitive sporting entertainment.
